gems.title: 欢迎来龙餐馆
gems.titleEn: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
gems.summary: 徐福为养家还债远赴中东中餐馆当厨师，在当地结识了大堂经理马俊生。他们以地道中国风味广招八方来客，龙餐馆声名鹊起。然而随着战争爆发，当地形势急转直下，没有人能够独善其身，徐福和马俊生也不例外，他们的命运将何去何从？战火中的龙餐馆又将如何维系？
gems.summaryEn: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds w
gems.whyWatch: 高分冷门华语战争剧情，小人物在异乡炮火中的命运让人揪心。
gems.whyWatchEn: A high-rated overlooked Chinese war drama about ordinary people trapped in a Middle Eastern conflict.
gems.audience: 喜欢华语现实题材与战争史诗的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of Chinese realist drama and war epics.

gems.title: 夜巡毒枭
gems.summary: 两位墨西哥员警不幸得罪一名残忍的毒枭后，必须拼命撑过值勤的最后几小时。改编自真实事件。
gems.summaryEn: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.
gems.whyWatch: 真实事件改编的限时逃命执法片，紧张感贯穿最后一班岗。
gems.whyWatchEn: A real-event-inspired thriller where two cops must survive their final shift against a ruthless cartel.
gems.audience: 喜欢高强度警匪动作与真实罪案改编的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who love high-intensity police thrillers and true-crime adaptations.

gems.title: 属于我的孩子
gems.summary: 在这部令人震惊的纪录片中，承受家人和社会的期望的女子迫切地想要个孩子，因此假装怀孕，并卷入一起犯罪。
gems.summaryEn: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.
gems.whyWatch: 令人震惊的纪录片，揭开假怀孕与犯罪背后被逼到绝境的女性心理。
gems.whyWatchEn: A startling documentary about a desperate woman who fakes pregnancy and spirals into crime.
gems.audience: 关注社会纪实和女性处境的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers interested in social documentaries and women's struggles.

gems.title: 爱恋成婚
gems.summary: 新娘结婚后拒绝离开娘家，她的丈夫必须考虑是否能够适应居住在岳父岳母屋檐下的生活。
gems.summaryEn: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.
gems.whyWatch: 反套路婚后喜剧，丈夫搬进岳父母家，文化笑点与情感温度兼具。
gems.whyWatchEn: A refreshing post-wedding comedy with a husband moving in with in-laws, blending culture clash and heart.
gems.audience: 喜欢轻松爱情喜剧和婚姻话题的观众
gems.audienceEn: Audiences who enjoy light rom-coms and relationship dynamics.

gems.title: 我们未曾有过的
gems.summary: 改编自爱丽丝·凯伦（Alice Kellen）同名畅销小说。失去父母后，有志成为画家的利亚（Leah）难以应对。当她的哥哥搬走后，他请最好的朋友阿克塞尔（Axel）照顾她，却不知道她对他一直以来的感情。
gems.summaryEn: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grap
gems.whyWatch: 改编畅销小说的暗恋与治愈系爱情，细腻情感和遗憾美学值得一看。
gems.whyWatchEn: A tender adaptation about unspoken love and healing, full of emotional nuance and wistful beauty.
gems.audience: 喜欢细腻爱情故事与小说改编的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of delicate romance dramas and book adaptations.

gems.title: 幸运女神
gems.summary: 一宗涉及数百万美元的劫案搞砸后，骗徒幸儿被迫亡命天涯。在联邦调查局与冷血黑帮大佬的夹击下，幸儿必须为生存而战，设法逃出生天。
gems.summaryEn: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.
gems.whyWatch: 女主亡命劫案题材，FBI与黑帮双重夹击下节奏凌厉、爽感十足。
gems.whyWatchEn: A slick crime drama about a female con artist on the run from the FBI and a mob boss.
gems.audience: 喜欢快节奏犯罪逃亡与女性主角剧集的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who like fast-paced crime thrillers with a female lead.

gems.title: 权力的游戏前传：龙族
gems.summary: 在维斯特洛大陆，坦格利安家族的衰落被公之于众。一场被称为“血龙狂舞”的内战即将爆发。
gems.summaryEn: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins wh
gems.whyWatch: 坦格利安家族史诗进入血龙狂舞，龙之家族第三季内战全面爆发。
gems.whyWatchEn: The Targaryen saga reaches the Dance of the Dragons as civil war erupts in Season 3.
gems.audience: 《权力的游戏》粉丝与奇幻史诗爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Game of Thrones fans and epic fantasy lovers.
